description: React functional component for a music player control bar, providing playback, skip, shuffle, repeat, and volume controls.

methods.name: handlePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles between play and pause states.

methods.name: handleSkip
methods.description: Skips to the next or previous track based on the direction parameter.

methods.name: handleVolume
methods.description: Adjusts the volume based on slider input.
